verdict.rationale: Wave's own pricing page confirms users can create bills, which covers the bill-capture part of this story. The pack has no evidence of approval routing or scheduling outbound vendor payments; the payments features shown are about collecting customer payments on invoices. Receipt OCR handles receipts, not vendor bills, so it is not credited. missing for 10: vendor bill capture/OCR detail, approval routing workflow, scheduled vendor bill payments, a unified single workflow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can capture vendor bills, route them for approval, and schedule payments from one workflow

citations.quote: Create unlimited estimates, invoices, bills, and bookkeeping records
